Specification: Custom E36 07K Mount Arms — NBR rubber isolators 43–68A no hydraulic
Notes: ⚠️ Race3 site shows E30 07K kit only (out of stock) — no confirmed E36-specific kit in any search result. Call before relying on as source. Custom fab is the likely path. Install: engine + trans drop as single pre-assembled unit (bellhousing mated, flexplate on, trans bolted before entering bay). Load leveler mandatory. Mock-up with temp tack-welded stub brackets while drivetrain suspended in final position; pull and finish-weld on bench. Isolator spec: NBR rubber sandwich pucks 43–68A durometer — NO hydraulic NO solid aluminum pucks. OEM E36 mounts are hydraulic (~55A per AKG) and cannot be reused regardless — 07K block geometry is incompatible with BMW mount bosses. Source rubber-to-metal bonded isolators from McMaster-Carr or Lord Corporation sized to bracket design at fab time. Ref durometer: MSW EEM 68A NBR race insert (moreheadspeedworks.com) is practical ceiling for dual-purpose build. ⚠️ LHD/RHD mirror: all directional references in 944 / Ur-Quattro / LS swap guides are reversed for this RHD car.

Specification: Garrett G-Series G30-770 REVERSE ROTATION
Notes: Verified $2731.20 (supercore $1883.91 + 0.83 A/R housing $847.29). If marginal: (a) vented/bubble hood, (b) step down to G25-660 RR (~$2000), (c) reverse rotation T3-inlet turbo from Precision Turbo (special order, eliminates adapter height). V-band connection is superior to T3 bolts \u2014 adapter is not a weakness, height is the only trade-off.

Specification: MaxxECU Custom 07K Harness (build offline) + Deutsch AS / Souriau 8STA firewall bulkhead connector
Notes: Build using MaxxECU CMC connector ends with VW sensor connectors (crank VR, cam Hall, CLT NTC, TPS, injectors EV14). Same ECU — harness swap replaces M5x harness at engine change. No additional ECU cost. RECOMMENDED: terminate both M52 and 07K harnesses at a 47- or 79-way Deutsch Autosport (AS series) or Souriau 8STA flanged bulkhead connector on the firewall. Cabin side wired permanently; each engine harness plugs in as a single unit. Engine swap = one connector disconnect. Install bulkhead during Phase 1 chassis prep. Budget ~$80-120 receptacle + ~$60-90 per mating plug + contacts. See Enhancements doc [ELECTRICAL] section.

Specification: EV14 2-pin USCAR housing + female terminals — 5 needed (07K I5) + 3 spare
Notes: DIRECT TERMINATION: buy housing + terminals — do not use pre-attached pigtail wire. Crimp EV14 female terminal (Bosch 1 928 499 000 or Delphi 12129476) onto harness wire using Engineer PA-09, seat until lance clicks. Housing: Bosch 1 928 402 258 or equiv USCAR. Amazon ASIN B07STLGB7Z (pigtail kit) usable for the housing — discard stub wire. EV14 is the standard 07K injector connector — direct fit for ID1050x. Source: 26-07k-harness.md line 14; wiring-bom.md System 3.

Specification: 4-pin VAG JPT housing OE# 4B0973724 + 2.8mm JPT contacts — buy 2×4-packs (5 + 3 spare)
Notes: DIRECT TERMINATION: buy housing + 2.8mm JPT female contacts — do not use pre-attached pigtail wire. Crimp 2.8mm JPT contact onto 18–20 AWG wire using IWISS IWS-2412M, seat into housing. Housing OE# 4B0973724. Amazon ASIN B093HK7PN1 usable for housing — discard stub wire. 07K I5 needs 5 housings × 4 pins = 20 contacts. Buy 2×4-packs for 5 installed + 3 spare housings. Source: 26-07k-harness.md line 14; wiring-bom.md System 2.

Component: 07K Cam + Crank + MAP Sensor Connector Housing + Terminals (3-pin VAG)
Specification: 3-pin VAG sensor housing OE# 3B0973703G + 1.5mm TE MCP contacts — buy 4 (3 + 1 spare)
Notes: DIRECT TERMINATION: buy housing + 1.5mm TE MCP sealed female contacts — do not use pre-attached pigtail wire. Crimp 1.5mm TE MCP contact onto 22 AWG signal wire using IWISS IWS-2820M, seat into housing. Housing OE# 3B0973703G. Terminals: TE MCP 1.5mm sealed female (TE PN 1-962-622-1 or equiv). Amazon ASIN B0DY4CC12Q (PARSUPPRO, $11.99 each) usable as housing source. CRITICAL: cam and crank share the same body but opposite pinouts — crank pin 1=VR+, pin 2=VR−, pin 3=shield; cam pin 1=+5V, pin 2=GND, pin 3=signal. Label housings at crimp time. Verify with multimeter on engine before plugging into MaxxECU. Source: maxxecu-07k.wv; MaxxECU REV9+ wiring PDF.

Component: 07K CLT + IAT + VVT Connector Housing + Terminals (2-pin Micro Timer)

Notes: DIRECT TERMINATION: buy housing + 1.5mm TE MCP sealed female contacts — same terminal family as 3B0973703G. Crimp using IWISS IWS-2820M. Housing OE# 1J0973702 / 8Z0820535. Specification: Injector Dynamics ID1050x - Set of 5 (replaces Phase 1A 630cc)

ID1050x is an EV14 connector (standard VW/Audi) \u2014 compatible with MaxxECU 07K harness EV14 injector connectors. Supports 600+whp on E85 at reasonable duty cycle. Notes: Verified $203.99 (TF-Works TIA485-2). Notes: The Boost Brothers longitudinal intake manifold has its own fuel rail provisions. Confirm fuel rail compatibility with BBG directly at time of intake order. Notes: The CXRacing FMIC core (Phase 1A) or purchased at Phase 3 (Option B) carries over, but the charge piping is turbo-position specific. The G30-770 reverse rotation + SPA MK5 manifold exits on the opposite side from the K64/M5x application. All Phase 1A CXRacing aluminum piping is unusable for 07K. Budget for custom mandrel-bent aluminum piping (local fab shop) or universal 2.5-3in elbow kit.

Specification: BBG kit component — assess at engine-in-car stage
Notes: The 07K factory thermostat housing exits at an angle incompatible with many swap bays. BBG 944 swap kit includes a thermostat housing adapter + 1.8T water neck (180 water neck) to convert the outlet direction for clean routing. FOR E36: assess at engine-in-car stage whether the factory 07K thermostat housing routes cleanly to the E36 radiator. If routing works, $0. If not, contact BBG — they include this in the 944 kit and may sell separately (~$50-100). DO NOT order before engine is positioned in bay. Confirmed in BBG Porsche 944 07K install video at 7:55.

Specification: Custom E36-to-07K Coolant Routing Kit
Notes: 07K coolant inlet/outlet locations differ from M52. The BBG intake manifold has coolant provisions (throttle body heat). iABED oil housing has coolant connections. Budget for custom silicone hoses (Samco or universal) to connect 07K ports to E36 CSF radiator. Measure routing at engine-in-car stage before ordering hose lengths. Gates or Vibrant universal silicone reducers + straight hoses.

Specification: Radium Engineering VTA Competition Catch Can — L (20-0772) or XL (20-0771)
Notes: MANDATORY for turbo build at high RPM. Two -10AN ORB inlet ports — direct fit to BBG billet valve cover -10AN crankcase port (Phase 2). Vent to atmosphere (VTA) — drain after every track day. L (20-0772): 0.6L. XL (20-0771): 0.9L — spec for Formula Drift minimum capacity compliance. Add -10AN hose (~$40-60). ALSO REQUIRED: address stock PCV port on intake manifold side — install one-way check valve or block off to prevent boost pressure back-feeding into crankcase. Oil consumption note: expect 50-150ml per track day in can post-break-in; near zero between street-only oil change intervals.

Specification: Column-Assist EPS — RHD: EPowerSteering E36 kit or Peugeot 206 GTi / Toyota MR2 ZZW30 salvage column
Notes: Column-assist EPS eliminates hydraulic pump entirely. Rack (stock or Z3 2.75-LTL upgrade) stays in place as manual rack. Options: (1) EPowerSteering.com E36-specific kit ($1300) — column core exchange required, VERIFY RHD column compatibility before ordering; (2) Peugeot 206 GTi or Toyota MR2 ZZW30 salvage EPS column ($50–100 donor + bracket fab) — RHD-native, documented in UK/AU community. Assist is fixed via dashboard potentiometer — KIT-33 Basic EPS Controller has no VSS or external input; speed-sensitive assist is not supported by this product. Z3 rack upgrade recommended: direct E36 bolt-in, 2.75 turns LTL, cap hydraulic lines.
